verdicts.finding: labels:The 8-gram leak gate is relative to gold
verdicts.reason: The mechanism is addressed: the current src/evrag/data/medquad.py (lines 342-373, 449-451, 481) adds a per-sentence restatement gate on top of the length-relative 8-gram gate. Every gold sentence with >= 6 distinctive content words (content words minus stop words minus the 11 words found in > 20% of chunks) is rejected when one chunk outside the unit holds >= 70% of them, and a verbatim sentence scores 1.0, so a one- or two-sentence verbatim copy can no longer hide at 3-9% of a long gold's 8-grams. The manifest shows 195 candidates rejected as 'restated' and 131 as 'leak'; the 6 tests pass; a scratch rebuild reproduces all four data files byte-for-byte. On the current data I searched all 120 B/C golds against corpus.jsonl: no gold sentence with >= 6 distinctive content words survives verbatim anywhere; the longest verbatim token run for any B/C row is 17 tokens, the largest share of a B/C gold found verbatim across remaining chunks is 25%, max leak_overlap 0.090, max sentence_overlap 0.667. No current gold answer contains footnote [n] markers, and the set-based gate is immune to them anyway. Concrete remaining cases: (1) MQ_C_CDC_0000121-8 (How to prevent Parasites - Cysticercosis?, leak 0.090, sentence_overlap 0.600): the gold is a period-free bullet list, so the splitter gives the gate two 30- and 25-word pseudo-sentences; the exact bullet 'Teach children the importance of washing hands to prevent infection' (7 distinctive words, would score 1.0 on its own) survives verbatim in 7 remaining chunks (CDC_0000030-7#0 Ascariasis, CDC_0000144-7#0/#1 Echinococcosis, CDC_0000327-7#1, CDC_0000414-7#1, CDC_0000415-7#1, CDC_0000432-7#0) and 17 of the 19 tokens of the hand-washing bullet sit in CDC_0000327-7#0 (Enterobiasis prevention). (2) Sentences under 6 distinctive words are exempt by design (RESTATE_MIN_WORDS): MQ_B_NINDS_0000054-2's exact sentence 'Other treatment is symptomatic and supportive.' is in 8 remaining chunks with leak 0.000 (6 tokens form no 8-gram), 'Treatment is (generally) symptomatic and supportive.' recurs for several rows (e.g. MQ_C_NINDS_0000010-2), and MQ_B_NINDS_0000073-2 (COFS treatment, 21 words) has no checked sentence at all, so its sentence_overlap 0.000 is vacuous. All surviving verbatim text is NIH template phrasing, not condition-specific content, so the substantive form of the defect is not reproducible on the current files.
verdicts.residual_risk: The gate's unit is the period-split sentence, so period-free bullet lists (9 B/C rows have >= 3 ' - ' bullets), sentences with fewer than 6 distinctive content words, and C pages' remaining sections that restate the asked section just under 70% (e.g. MQ_C_NINDS_0000072-2 Cerebral Palsy treatment vs its own Outlook chunk NINDS_0000072-3#0, 11-token run, 0.571) can still carry answer text past both gates. A should hand-check every B/C row with leak_overlap >= 0.05 or sentence_overlap >= 0.6 (and the 9 bullet-list rows), grepping the normalised corpus for each gold sentence and bullet separately, and D could split on ' - ' before the gate or add a cap on verbatim runs (e.g. >= 12 tokens outside known template phrases).
